title: Worked for a bit
text: Worked for a bit. Large bright display, unfortunately cord broke and no longer working in less than 2 months.

product_metadata.title: ROCAM Digital Alarm Clock - 7.5" Large Red Led Display, Loud Alarm, 7 Colored Night Light, Snooze, Dimmer, Dual USB Charger Ports, Battery Backup, 12/24 Hours for Bedrooms, Kids, Heavy Sleepers, Home
features: 【Easy To Operate & 7 Colored Night Light】- This digital alarm clock is designed to be user-friendly and easier to set up than its counterparts on the market, making it ideal for kids and seniors. You can easily press the SNOOZE button to get an extra 9 minutes of sleep. Additionally, the night light feature can be turned on or off, and the lighting is superior to many traditional night light alarm clocks, making it ideal for young children who may be afraid of the dark, and for boys and girls who prefer a bit of ambient lighting in their room.

【Digital Clock with 7.5-Inch Large Display】- The large number digital clock make it easy to read the time from across the room, whether you're a child or an adult. Seniors who may have difficulty seeing smaller fonts on traditional alarm clocks will appreciate the clear digits on this led clock.

【Adjustable 0-100% Brightness & 12/24h Customization】- You can adjust the brightness of the display to your preferred level, whether you prefer complete darkness or a subtle glow. The sliding button allows for a seamless adjustment, making it easy to customize the brightness according to your preferences.You can also easily set the 12/24 hour display and DST adjustment to suit your needs.

【Dual Usb Charging Ports & Backup Battery Settings】- This alarm clock with usb port can charge your phone, watch or tablet and other small electronic devices while you sleep. Additionally, the backup battery ensures that your alarm and time settings remain intact in the event of a power outage (the screen does not display).

【Loud Alarm Clock For Heavy Sleepers with Volume Control】- The alarm buzzer volume for this beside clock could be adjusted from Low-Medium-High level which is perfect for heavy sleepers or hearing impaired. Compact size alarm clock for bedroom, office and kitchen.

【Real ABS Material & Warranty Service】- ROCAM CR1008 Digital Alarm Clock was made of the real 100% ABS material, most of the electric clocks in the market will partically use the waste material so the cost will be lower (but we know it is harmful for users), in the mean time, this nightstand clock will impart a higher surface gloss than others. We offer 18 months warranty, 30 days money back and 24 hours customer service response, please feel free to contact us for any operation problems.

【Perfect Gift for Any Occasion】- The sleek and stylish design of the desk clock makes it a great gift for any occasion, whether it's Christmas, a birthday, New Year's, an anniversary or any other holiday. It's suitable for people of all ages and makes for a practical and thoughtful present.
